Upload: test_retry_after_timeout fails sometimes with a timeout
body:
## Summary

`tests/test_upload.py::test_retry_after_timeout` fails now and then with `AssertionError: expected 2 attempts, got 1`.

## Steps to reproduce

Not deterministic. Failed in 1 of 10 runs on CI.

## Environment

Python 3.11.9, pytest 8.2.0, the CI image.

comments.body: Seen once more on main, same assertion.
